asks.ask: When a hotfix worker opens its pull request, the pull request carries the hotfix label.
When a hotfix worker opens its pull request, the pull request links the issue it answers.
When a hotfix worker finds the ask needs a design choice, the planner starts on the issue.
When a hotfix worker sends the issue back to planning, the issue gets a comment saying why.
When an issue labeled hotfix is drawn, its card shows its state in one line.
When an issue labeled hotfix is drawn, its card line shows the ask.
When a hotfix has a pull request, its card line links that pull request.
When a hotfix code review ends, its card line shows the review verdict.
When a hotfix merge gate runs, its card line shows the gate's result.
The hotfix parts of the worker and reviewer prompts name nothing about Dokima's own repo.
